title: AI at Moscow conference judged Apollo photos synthetic

tellings.quote: where Putin was at this conference, this the AI conference of two years ago in Moscow.

plain: At an artificial intelligence conference in Moscow about two years before the episode, with Russian president Vladimir Putin present, an AI system is said to have judged photos from Apollo, the American moon landing missions, to be synthetic, meaning faked. The comedian and podcaster Joe Rogan tells it, passing on what he heard from Bart Sibrel, a filmmaker who argues the moon landings were staged. If true, it would cast doubt on the moon landing photos.
